assessment.question:
### Exercise 9.4: Solve open sentences

10. 40 \div x = 8
assessment.expected_answer:
$$
\begin{align}
40 \div x \times x &= 8 \times x \\
40 &= 8 \times x  \\
40 \div 8 &= 8 \div 8 \times x \\
5 &= x \\
x &= 5
\end{align}
$$
